_note: The vis half of the same pair: every AE2 upgrade card is one of its basic cards plus an ingredient, and this one is a basic card plus a crystal that carries the aura aspect. Same base card and the same shape as the access card, so neither of the two is the cheaper one.
_crystal: The auram vis crystal is matched as a component rather than as a plain item, the shape vis_interface.json already uses: the aspect lives in a data component, so an item-only ingredient could not name it.
